source.rightsEvidence: The requester attested on 2026-09-26 that clearance covers full-page screenshot retention, derived prompts, and pipeline-model visual-reference use. No source-owner grant file was uploaded.

provenance.capture: Captured the official website directly at 1440x900 and 390x844. Lazy images were set eager for the capture session, scrolled into view, and decoded. All images loaded. The desktop page is narrower than viewport but has no overflow; the capture includes the complete viewport.
provenance.diagnostics: The site uses a dark navy photo-led hero with a serif statement and orange contact action; it continues through proof bites, service categories, industry groupings, process, team/testimonial, and contact close. All source identity, credentials, people, reviews, pricing, service claims and photography remain source-only.

referenceDna.annotatedDescription: A local-practice accounting site begins with a utility contact strip, compact nav, and navy photographic hero. A large serif promise and concise plain-language subcopy are balanced with a primary conversation action and secondary services path. Four trust details follow before categorized services, a dark sector-fit band, structured work process, concise why-us contrast, client feedback, and an assertive contact close. Orange marks actions and highlights. Source logo, staff, proof claims, prices, testimonials, professional registration, location and copy remain source-only.

heroGeometry.mode: deep-navy photo-led hero with a large serif promise aligned left
heroGeometry.alignment: headline and explanation occupy the left of a wide cropped office image, followed by a primary colored action and quieter secondary route
heroGeometry.viewport: opening promise and conversion are visible above the fold, followed by a slim trust strip

navigationGeometry.mode: utility contact rail with white wordmark/navigation strip
navigationGeometry.placement: phone/email utility above or beside primary nav, with conversation CTA at the end
navigationGeometry.mobile: compact logo and menu with a direct contact path kept reachable

typography.scale: large two-line practice promise, concise body, small proof labels, readable service text

palette.contrastIntent: orange marks actions; body and proof remain legible over image and light surfaces

imageTreatment.mode: darkened office/document context in the opening, followed by consultation/process scenes
imageTreatment.crop: wide hero background and medium rectangular editorial images
imageTreatment.focalPoint: the type and action remain primary while the image signals business context

servicePresentation.pattern: categorized service groups with short descriptions, followed by a separate sector-fit taxonomy
servicePresentation.interaction: direct service routes and compact sector links; show only client-approved services and specialties

ctaPlacement.primary: conversation CTA inside the opening promise
ctaPlacement.secondary: service/details route beside or immediately after it
ctaPlacement.early: show proof details before the full service taxonomy and process narrative

motion.primitive: visitor-controlled testimonial rail or small transitions, never autoplay

rules: stack promise, actions and trust details before catalog
stack service groups in reading order
avoid cramped chips and tiny testimonial text

prohibitedPatterns: source name, logo, phone number, location, professional registration or staff
source prices, promises, testimonials, client count or response expectations
stock portraits presented as the client's people
unverified credentials, savings, tax outcomes or offices
generic finance charts and duplicated trust claims
invented client proof or regulatory badges

requiredSignatureElements.description: plain-language practice promise over restrained business-context imagery
up to four concise proof details with verified provenance
distinct service categories with clear descriptions and direct paths
sector routing limited to client-confirmed specialties

acceptanceChecks: contact, location, credentials, service scope, pricing and proof are verified
one primary conversion path appears in the hero
service groups help visitors identify fit
supporting trust details add new information
all imagery is client-owned or separately licensed/generated
mobile nav and service labels are legible without overflow

review.scope: requester-attested direct-site evidence, local-accountancy business fit and non-transferable claims
